description:
Use this when the user wants a link to share RipClip with friends: "give me my invite link", "how many
        people joined from my link", "I want to invite another streamer". Returns the account's own link (made on the
        first call, the same every time) and how many accounts joined with it. No parameters.
        Not for: adding someone to the user's team (invite_team_member) or the public profile address
        (get_public_profile). Free and read only; the link carries no reward.
name: get_invite_link
title: Get my invite link
